lines.zh: 我踩着固定的步幅前进
lines.en: I advance at a fixed stride.

lines.zh: 四格半的身子挡了不少光
lines.en: My tall frame blocks a lot of light.

lines.zh: 我的脚落地时先脚跟再脚尖
lines.en: Heel first, then toe, every step.
Villagers slip indoors as I pass.

lines.zh: 我沿着同一路线走第三圈
lines.en: Third loop along the same route.

lines.zh: 铁腿碾过碎石，碎得很细
lines.en: My iron legs grind gravel to grit.

lines.zh: 我抬臂避开低垂的树枝
lines.en: I lift an arm clear of a low branch.

lines.zh: 草原上，我像一根行走的柱子
lines.en: On the savanna I'm a walking pillar.

lines.zh: 雪原的冷对我没有影响
lines.en: The snowfield cold does nothing to me.

lines.zh: 每一步都落在预设的点上
lines.en: Each step lands on a preset point.

lines.zh: 关节的响声隔着墙都听得见
lines.en: My joints are heard through walls.
Turning, my foot gouges the soil.

lines.zh: 我停在一棵树下，挡了荫
lines.en: I stop under a tree and take its shade.
My optical head twitches.
The system runs a self-check.

lines.zh: 红缎带的军规有四十条
lines.en: Red Ribbon has forty rules.
I've gone through them one by one.
The fruit on this tree is nearly ripe.

lines.zh: 有孩子在窗后数我的手指
lines.en: A child counts my fingers from a window.
I shouldn't stand in someone's doorway.
But the order didn't move me.
I shift my weight to the left leg.
There's rain in the air.

lines.zh: 下了雨，我的关节会响得更勤
lines.en: In rain my joints click more.
Scanning: no threats.

lines.zh: 我等着那道熟悉的指令音
lines.en: I wait for the familiar command tone.
Someone drives cattle over a bridge far off.

lines.zh: 我把手掌翻过来看了看
lines.en: I turn my palm over and look at it.
The paint on my palm has worn away.

lines.zh: 这些细节，我不会写进报告
lines.en: I won't put such details in the report.

lines.zh: 你站在我的影子里，我不介意
lines.en: You stand in my shadow. I don't mind.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，镜头重新对焦
lines.en: I look down and my lens refocuses.
You don't look like Red Ribbon.

lines.zh: 你的装备很杂，来源不明
lines.en: Your gear is mixed and untraceable.
My warning comes only once.

lines.zh: 你听得出我关节的声音吗
lines.en: Can you hear my joints?

lines.zh: 你的手离枪柄只有两指。
lines.en: Your hand is two fingers from the hilt.
I recognise that motion.
Three seconds. I'll count them out.
You didn't leave. So be it.
My arm comes up.
No more words before the strike.
My shoulder plate rings from the blow.

lines.zh: 传感器跳了一下，我稳住
lines.en: My sensor jumps; I steady.
This doesn't stop my advance.
Static runs through my circuits.
A scratch on my plate. I'll patch it later.
My stride shortens by an inch.
For me, pain is only a signal.
The decision hasn't changed.
Accurate, but not heavy enough.
Keep going. I'm calculating you.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，我扫描过了
lines.en: I've already scanned what's in your hand.

lines.zh: 不是红石，就不是我要的
lines.en: Not redstone, so it's not what I want.
Approaching with that means nothing.
Red Ribbon rules forbid gifts.

lines.zh: 你想拖时间，我看得出来
lines.en: You're stalling. I can tell.
Back up and keep it.

lines.zh: 我的传感器不会因此放松
lines.en: My sensors won't relax for it.
The more you hesitate, the faster I decide.
I won't call it bait this time.
Go, so I don't have to recalculate.

lines.zh: 你的冲击传到我腿上就没了
lines.en: Your impact dies at my leg.
I look down and see you pull away.

lines.zh: 碰撞没有影响我的判定
lines.en: The collision didn't change my decision.

lines.zh: 别碰我的膝，那里有销子
lines.en: Don't touch my knee; there's a pin there.

lines.zh: 我的重量全压在地面上
lines.en: All my weight presses into the ground.
You strike with a muffled clang.
I shift half a step and give you the road.
Your shoulder's shaking. Steady first.
This one I won't count.
Don't hit me a second time.
I take the right side of a formation.
I'll leave your place open.

lines.zh: 这台机体的右侧有护板
lines.en: This unit has a plate on its right side.
Come close and the wind drops.
I have no body heat to give you.

lines.zh: 但我能替你挡一整个下午
lines.en: But I can shield you all afternoon.
Red Ribbon wouldn't understand.
So I won't write it in the report.
Walk with me. I'll match your pace.

lines.zh: 别走太快，我的步子太沉
lines.en: Don't go too fast; my steps fall heavy.
I have to drop to one knee to reach it.
Redstone. Logged and stored.
Iron ingot. Weight within spec.

lines.zh: 我的手指太粗，夹了两次
lines.en: My fingers are thick; I try twice.
I saw you drop it.
This belongs to the corps.
I'm collecting all of it.
Useless items go back where they were.
Into the compartment, locked.
Collection complete. Standing.
Three seconds. Decision begins.
I've marked you red.

lines.zh: 长臂的打击范围够到你
lines.en: Your position is inside my arm's reach.
I take one step forward.
Don't count on the villagers.
My pursuit line is straight.
Four blocks. Still closing.
No margin this time.
Lens locked. Not releasing.
The clearance routine has begun.
Twice you tried to flank me.
I don't turn fast, but fast enough.

lines.zh: 你的武器挡不住这个重量
lines.en: Your weapon can't hold this weight.

lines.zh: 我在等你落脚的那一瞬
lines.en: I wait for the instant you plant a foot.
You've backed to the field ridge.
Soft ground. You can't run well.
My shadow arrives before my foot.
There's no second way out of here.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸每三次乱一次
lines.en: Every third breath of yours breaks.
Now, then. No more delay.
The iron palm comes down from above.
I sweep a leg and soil turns up.
This one hits your chest square.
You're knocked back into a tree.
Weight is more reliable than speed.
My hand clamps your shoulder plate.

lines.zh: 你一挣，我反而握得更紧
lines.en: The more you pull, the tighter I hold.

lines.zh: 这一拳落下，地动了一下
lines.en: The fist lands and the ground jumps.
Your knees gave.
Clearance in progress.

lines.zh: 我站在村口，挡了半条路
lines.en: I stand at the gate, blocking half the road.
Third patrol unit powered.

lines.zh: 脚下的草被我的影子压暗
lines.en: My shadow darkens the grass below.

lines.zh: 这里的人不认识我，很快就认识
lines.en: They don't know me here. They will soon.

lines.zh: 我从雪原那边过来，腿还凉
lines.en: I come from the snowfield; my legs are still cold.

lines.zh: 我的编号只有红缎带看得懂
lines.en: Only Red Ribbon reads my serial.

lines.zh: 四格半的高度，够看清田地
lines.en: At this height I see the whole field.
Startup complete. Lens focusing.
A sparrow lands on my shoulder.
I shake it off.
Patrol begins. Please keep clear.
I know this route by heart.
A black patch burns onto my shell.

lines.zh: 砸落时腿部液压全泄了
lines.en: Landing hard, my leg hydraulics vent out.

lines.zh: 水从接缝渗进去，我往上走
lines.en: Water seeps through seams; I head up.

lines.zh: 冲击把我的外壳掀开条缝
lines.en: The blast opens a crack in my shell.

lines.zh: 箭扎进关节缝里，转起来卡
lines.en: An arrow in my joint makes it stick.

lines.zh: 这股力量让我的系统短暂空白
lines.en: That force blanks my system briefly.

lines.zh: 能源将尽，我的动作变慢了
lines.en: Energy nearly gone; my motions slow.

lines.zh: 一道雷沿着我的铁壳跑过
lines.en: Lightning runs the length of my shell.

lines.zh: 下方没有地面，我在坠落
lines.en: No ground below. I am falling.
